systems.name: York County, SC Public Safety
systems.description: The York County, South Carolina Public Safety P25 radio system carries all Law Enforcement, Fire, EMS, and government services traffic for York County, South Carolina on a single, unified public safety grade radio system.

systems.name: Camden County Georgia Public Safety
systems.description:
Camden EMS & Fire on P25 phase II, and Camden County Sheriff. 

 St Mary's and Kingsland Police are now encrypted/unavailable.

systems.name: Palmetto 800
systems.description: PD-SD-FD-EMS Monitoring the Sumter, SC simulcast of the Palmetto 800 P25 Trunked System. Includes some adjacent systems, and public transport. Running on five RTL-SDR Blog v3 radios, fed via amplified UHF antenna, supporting recording concurrent calls on every channel.

systems.description: Broadcasting volunteer fire departments in Aiken county
